description: Restructure the right sidebar (home-aside.tsx) to show: Hot Articles Top5, Active Groups Recommendation, My Status (checkin/tasks/level), and Site Announcement.
steps: Add new i18n keys in both zh-CN.ts and en-US.ts: component.homeAside.hotArticles ('热门文章'/'Hot Articles'), component.homeAside.activeGroups ('活跃群组'/'Active Groups'), component.homeAside.myStatus ('我的状态'/'My Status'), component.homeAside.viewMore ('查看更多'/'View More'). Also add keys for status labels: component.homeAside.dailyCheckin ('今日签到'/'Daily Check-in'), component.homeAside.taskProgress ('任务进度'/'Task Progress'), component.homeAside.levelExp ('等级/经验'/'Level/XP').

In web/components/layout/home-aside.tsx: Reorder and restructure the widgets. New order: (1) Site Announcement (existing SiteNotice, keep as-is), (2) Hot Articles Top5 widget - fetch articles using apiFetch<PageData<Article>>('/api/article/articles', { params: { sort: 'hot' } }) and display top 5 as a list with title, view count, and link. (3) Active Groups widget - fetch groups using apiFetch<GroupItem[]>('/api/group/list') and show 2-3 groups with name, member count, and join link. (4) My Status widget - combine the existing CheckInCard, TasksUserCard info into a compact status card showing checkin status, level/exp from user object, and a link to /tasks.

Create a HotArticlesWidget component within home-aside.tsx that fetches the top 5 articles and renders them as a numbered list inside a WidgetCard. Each item shows rank number, article title (truncated), and view count.
Create an ActiveGroupsWidget component that fetches groups and shows 2-3 recommended ones inside a WidgetCard. Each shows group icon/name, member count, and a 'join' or 'enter' link.
Create a MyStatusWidget that shows the current user's check-in streak, daily task progress (if available), and level/exp in a compact card format. Only show when user is logged in.
Remove or reduce the ScoreRank widget and FriendLinks widget (they can remain but move below the new widgets or be removed entirely to keep the sidebar focused).
acceptance_criteria: Right sidebar shows widgets in order: Site Announcement, Hot Articles Top5, Active Groups, My Status (logged in only), then existing ScoreRank/FriendLinks
Hot Articles widget displays up to 5 articles with title and view count
Active Groups widget displays 2-3 groups with name and member count
My Status widget shows check-in status and level/exp for logged-in users
All new text uses i18n t() function
verification: Run `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit` to verify no type errors
findings: All changes compile cleanly with tsc --noEmit. Removed TasksUserCard, CheckInCard, and Badge import since they are consolidated into MyStatusWidget. The CheckInInfo type uses 'checkIn' boolean property (not 'checkedIn'). Kept ScoreRank and FriendLinks at lower priority below the new widgets. Post-review fix: removed redundant JS title truncation in HotArticlesWidget, letting CSS line-clamp-1 handle overflow.
